name: 上海实验室
reconstruction: four photos with hand-picked corners and edges, fitted jointly (fit_photo.py), build_scene.py, check_scene.py, preview.py (PLAN.md); room furniture (desks, chairs, pedestal, cabinet, side and round tables) placed by back-projecting floor contacts through the fitted cameras, catalogue sizes
scale_basis: estimated: tabletop height prior 0.75 +- 0.015 m; the fitted length and width are within 2 % of the standard 1.4 x 0.7 m

photo_overlay.method: phone photos, cameras fitted to the same hand-picked pixels (fit_photo.py), so in-sample; tabletop corners and edges only; not the robot-camera overlay (overlay)

lighting.note: colour temperature and brightness ratio matched to phone photo p3 (6500 K, 24000); not compared with the head camera

photo_match.method: Isaac RTX from each fitted photo camera (scripts/scenes/render_scenes.py --photos), median CIELAB of photo vs render over the whole frame, averaged over the photos; target |dL*| <= 5, |db*| <= 3; phone auto exposure and white balance make it indicative only

notes: Assumes the robot stands on the open side without the panel; if it stands at the panel, turn the Room 180 deg.
